The deduplication function in src/ingest/dedupe.ts does not correctly handle overlapping days when two statements with overlapping date ranges are uploaded together. It uses a simple key based on the date, amount, and description, but this does not account for the scenario where statements are uploaded in quick succession. As a result, transactions that should be detected as duplicates across two uploads are missed if they happen very close in time, leading to duplicated days in the ledger.

input.title: Fix dedupe to correctly detect duplicates in overlapping statement uploads
input.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The current dedupe function misses duplicates when two statements with overlapping days are uploaded together in the same batch, leading to duplicate transactions in the ledger. The fix should improve duplicate detection for transactions occurring on overlapping days within a single upload batch, ensuring the first occurrence wins and later duplicates are correctly identified and excluded.
